bibl.title: The Changing Sacred Landscape of Egypt's Western Desert in Late Antiquity: The Case of ‘Ain el-Gedida.
bibl.seg: Nicola Aravecchia, The Changing Sacred Landscape of Egypt's Western Desert in Late Antiquity: The Case of ‘Ain el-Gedida.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Overview of the site. - The fourth-century church complex. - Changes in the built environment. - The west complex [identified as a small-scale mudbrick temple, later converted into a ceramic workshop]. - Discussion.
